map.输入加油量、行驶里程与油价，计算百公里油耗、单次油费、可续航里程与碳排放: Enter fuel quantity, distance driven and fuel price to compute consumption per 100 km, the cost of this fill-up, remaining range and carbon emissions
map.百公里油耗 = 加油量(L) ÷ 行驶里程(km) × 100；总油费 = 加油: Consumption per 100 km = fuel(L) ÷ distance(km) × 100; total fuel cost = fuel quantity × unit price; monthly fuel cost = monthly distance ÷ 100 × consumption × unit price; remaining range = fuel remaining ÷ consumption × 100.
map.急加速、急刹车会显著抬高瞬时油耗。保持匀速、预判路况，城市工况可省油 10%–1: Hard acceleration and braking raise instantaneous consumption sharply. Holding a steady speed and reading the road ahead saves 10%–15% in urban driving.
map.胎压低于标准 20% 约增加 3% 油耗；按期更换空滤、机油，让发动机维持在设计: Pressure 20% below standard adds about 3% to consumption; change air filter and oil on schedule so the engine keeps running as designed.
map.车顶行李架、过多随车重物都会抬高风阻与滚动阻力。长途前清理后备箱可降耗。: Roof racks and excess cargo raise drag and rolling resistance; clear the trunk before long trips to cut consumption.
map.💡 油耗是滚动参考值：基于近期加油与里程推算，路况、空调、载重变化都会让实际值偏: 💡 Consumption is a rolling figure based on recent fill-ups and distance; traffic, A/C and load all shift the real value. On long trips trust your actual refueling rhythm.
map.加油后输入加油量、里程与油价，算百公里油耗、单次油费与可续航里程。: After refueling, enter fuel quantity, distance and price to get consumption per 100 km, the cost of that fill and remaining range.
map.按月行驶量估算月度油费与碳排放，做用车成本预算。: Estimate monthly fuel cost and carbon emissions from monthly distance to budget running costs.
map.对比不同驾驶风格（经济/运动）下的油耗，反馈节油效果。: Compare consumption under different driving styles (eco / sport) to see the savings.
map.本次加油 40L、行驶 560km；百公里油耗=40÷560×100≈7.14L: Adding 40L and driving 560km gives 40÷560×100 ≈ 7.14L/100km. With 10L left at unchanged consumption, remaining range ≈ 10÷7.14×100 ≈ 140km; at 8 yuan/L this fill costs 40×8 = 320 yuan.
map.L/100km 和 mpg 怎么换算？: How do L/100km and mpg convert?
map.L/100km 与 mpg 互为倒数关系：mpg(US)≈235.2÷L/100: L/100km and mpg are reciprocal: mpg(US) ≈ 235.2 ÷ L/100km and mpg(UK) ≈ 282.5 ÷ L/100km. Lower L/100km means thirstier while higher mpg means thriftier, so do not mix up the direction.
map.续航估算为什么常不准？: Why is range estimation often inaccurate?
map.续航基于近期平均油耗与剩余油量，若接下来上高速或堵车，实际油耗偏离均值，续航就会: Range rests on the recent average consumption and fuel remaining; if the next stretch is highway cruising or stop-and-go traffic, real consumption drifts from the mean and the range figure fails. Treat it as a rolling reference and trust your actual refueling rhythm on long trips.
